# PANINI-DR

> PANINI-DR is a multi-agent deep-research harness for answering hard multi-step questions over a document collection. It keeps the investigation's state in an explicit shared workspace (built on the Generative Semantic Workspace representation) and has a separate Verifier check every intermediate finding against its cited evidence before it is reused. Paper: "PANINI-DR: Controlled Deep Research through Generative Semantic Workspaces" (arXiv:2610.15208), University of California, Los Angeles.

Key results (all harnesses use gpt-oss-120b, the same frozen corpora and the same retrieval service):

- BrowseComp-Plus (CF-150): 73.3% accuracy, 16.0 points above the next-best of seven state-of-the-art deep-research harnesses (SLEUTH, 57.3%); 52% on hard questions against 28% for the next best.
- Best average accuracy across BrowseComp-Plus, FRAMES and MoNaCo: 69.1 against 63.4.
- Highest observed support (answer credit recoverable from the saved evidence) on all three benchmarks: average 60.9 against 49.6.

## Links

- [Project page](https://roychowdhuryresearch.github.io/PANINI-DR_Project_Page/): interactive Figure 1, results, citation
